description: Update the recorded state of an analytics insight in workspace_id. Supply insightId and action (view, dismiss, or act_upon). Marks the insight as viewed, dismissed, or acted upon; it does not carry out the recommendation itself. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

insightId.description: ID of the insight to act upon.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_analytics_insight
title: Update Analytics Insight
